# golden-files

> Golden file assertions for Go tests: update via a flag field, normalizers for line endings and volatile text, line diffs and safe names Go module `github.com/Trysac/u194-golden-files`, package `goldenfiles`, MIT licensed,
> Go >= 1.23, standard library only.

- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): shape of the package and its public API
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run and extend the tests
